_note: Hand-picked BEFORE any code was written or run. Labeler: Claude (the AI assistant that built this tool), after reading all 50 scripts once. NOT reviewed by a human editor - subjective and small. Each entry is the beat I would expect a promo to contain. 'alts' = acceptable alternative beats in the same episode. Split: 'dev' may be used to tune weights; 'heldout' is scored once at the end.
match_rule: A tool promo 'hits' a golden beat if overlap_seconds / min(len_core, len_promo_segment_union) >= 0.6 on the same episode.
